messages:
Alex K: morning sync — yesterday: finished AZ failover smoke test for pool-2. Blockers: spot eviction spike at 03:00 caused ~15% capacity loss, autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough. Today: working on faster fallback to reserved nodes and metric alert tuning. @Cheng L can you share the recent scaling run logs? :coffee:

Cheng L: saw the spike, digging. put a pointer to logs: s3://rdf-logs/gpu/2026-03-16/scale-run.log. Quick note: one of the spot groups hit provider-side throttling; added retry jitter in the autoscaler PR (WIP) — needs review. Also saw an OOM on a small batch job, but that's separate.

Olivia T: FYI quota request for ap-southeast increase to 120 GPUs is pending approval — finance asked for cost justification. Who owns the cost calc? @Maria P? :thinking_face:

Maria P: I'll run an updated workload profile and send numbers by EOD. Preliminary estimate: +18% monthly cost if we keep a full extra buffer for peak. I can also model a mixed buffer with spot-prefer routing — lower cost.

Alex K: for short-term relief, can we route low-priority batch jobs to spot-only pools during peak hours? Should free up ~6–8 GPUs for real-time traffic.

Cheng L: yes, that's doable. I'll add a routing rule and test in staging. Draft snippet:

```
policy:
  route: spot_prefer
  fallback: reserved_pool
  max_latency_ms: 250
```

I'll run a dry-run tonight.

provision-bot: deploy started for branch autoscaler/jitter-fix — CI: 88% — ETA ~6m.

Olivia T: small reminder — AMS quota renewal is due in 10 days, need the renewal request + usage justification. @Alex K can you draft the request?

Alex K: noted, I'll drop a PR in infra-ops/docs with the usage + SLA summary by noon.

Cheng L: autoscaler/jitter-fix deployed to staging, smoke tests passed. I'll watch the 00:00–04:00 window and set a temporary alert: capacity-drop >10% for 5m.

Maria P: uploaded cost workbook: https://redwood.internal/docs/infra/gpu-costs-apr.xlsx — please comment. I'll include the mixed-buffer scenario in the sheet.

Alex K: thanks everyone. No blockers from my side now. Action items: Cheng — merge routing rule + monitor; Maria — finalize cost numbers; Olivia — start quota renewal doc; Alex — PR for renewal. Back after monitoring window. :white_check_mark:
